notes: Points Area: click as many points as you like around a room and close on the first point; the edges follow the plan's lines and an outline that is another shape (a zone around the room) is no longer taken
New areas fill their Area name and Location from the room labels printed inside them (one room: its name and code; several rooms: each name once and their codes, within 100 characters)
Switch uplinks can be 10M (RJ45) and 100M (SFP); switch ports can be 10M and 100M
